Categories.why: Eight product categories keyed by CategoryID with a name, description and picture, pointed at only by Products.

CustomerCustomerDemo.why: Empty: declared as a link of customers to demographic types, but there are no rows to place it from.

CustomerDemographics.why: Empty: declared as a key plus a description, but there are no rows to place it from.

Customers.why: One row per customer company keyed by CustomerID with contact and address; Orders points at it.

EmployeeTerritories.why: Pure link of EmployeeID and TerritoryID, keyed by the pair.

Employees.why: Nine staff keyed by EmployeeID with names, addresses and birth and hire dates (business dates); Orders points at it and ReportsTo is a self-reference.

Order Details.why: Lines of an order keyed by OrderID and ProductID with price and quantity; a line item, so an event whose time sits on Orders.

Orders.why: One row per order, stamped with OrderDate; CustomerID and EmployeeID repeat across orders.

Products.why: One row per product keyed by ProductID, pointing at Suppliers and Categories; Order Details points at it.

Region.why: Four region names keyed by RegionID, pointed at only by Territories.

Shippers.why: Three shipping companies keyed by ShipperID with a name and a phone number, contact details that describe a company; Orders points at it.

Suppliers.why: One row per supplier keyed by SupplierID with contact and address; Products points at it.

Territories.why: 53 sales territories keyed by TerritoryID, pointing at Region; the territory side of the EmployeeTerritories bridge.
